images.prompt:
EDIT IMAGE 1 by outpainting ONLY its black placeholder rectangle, x=256..1535 and y=256..1023. Deliver ONE 1536x1024 PNG. Image 1 is the actual canvas with painted neighbouring pixels: keep the entire TOP 256 ROWS and LEFT 256 COLUMNS exactly unchanged, including their black gaps and the top-left corner. Image 2 is a STYLE reference only; never copy its layout or objects.
CRITICAL SEAM REPAIR: the existing upper cloud bank is cut off by the placeholder at row 256. Continue that bank DOWNWARD across row 256 at every painted contact, extending its peach/rose/lavender masses into softly irregular billowing lobes at different depths before dissolving into wisps. There must be NO horizontal cutoff, straight seam, or black band touching the cut bottom of that bank. Likewise continue every wisp entering from column 255 naturally rightward across column 256. Merge these continuations organically. Preserve the neighbour strips rather than repainting them.
Subject: isolated MIST parallax layer, lower-right panel of a continuous 2x2 panorama. Only pale warm mist and low cloud, sunset-lit peach, rose and lavender, painted as LIGHT over flat PURE BLACK #000000 (black means transparent in game). Open spaces are pure black, never coloured sky. In the unpainted upper half use thin drifting wisps below the flowing edge of the existing top cloud bank; progressively thicken toward the bottom into dense rolling cloud banks, continuing the dense warm mist already at the bottom of the left strip. The bottom and right may be crossed by mist, no decorative framing or vignette. Soft cloud boundaries, clean painted colour planes, restrained surface texture, hand-drawn painted 2D animation-game environment register, distant fine contours and graphic jewel-toned lighting consistent with the supplied painted strips and reference. Match the supplied strips' colour, brush character, scale and softness exactly for seamless continuity.
No land, cliff rim, rocks, trees, architecture, sun disc, sky colour, characters, creatures, text, UI, border, or vignette. No green background: this specific mist layer uses pure black. Do not resize or shift the existing painted canvas.

references.role: edit target — painted neighbour strips and placeholder
